summary.note: systems[] lists program-scale gaps (missing_pieces). sot_partial_forward_queue_batches is derived from SOT §11.4 lines whose status token is PARTIAL, NOT DONE, or BLOCKED — regenerate with this script.
sot_discipline: Edit docs/RUNMYCAMPUS_SINGLE_EXECUTION_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md §11.4 first when changing batch status.
Run: python scripts/generate_system_closure_map.py --write whenever PARTIAL, NOT DONE, or BLOCKED §11.4 rows are added, removed, or retitled so sot_partial_forward_queue_batches stays aligned.
systems[].missing_pieces and gap_status change only when a slice ships or honest scope changes — pair with a §11.4 DONE row + tests/verifiers where applicable.
Program gaps remain open until explicitly closed; do not claim closure from ledger edits alone.
